affected_subject.reason: Identifies Book._updateLimitPostOrder and the price-level doubly linked list it maintains.

trigger_or_action.reason: Appending a new order writes back-link to memory copy, leaving prevOrderId==0; cancelling/matching a non-head order triggers the faulty removal.

direct_effect.reason: Removal moves headOrder past real head, orphaning orders, desyncing counters, and flipping best bid/ask to MAX_UINT sentinel.

safety_relation_basis.reason: States invariant that every order must be reachable via headOrder/tailOrder chain and open-interest must reflect reachable orders only.

summary: Report identifies the affected function, the faulty back-link write trigger, concrete orphaning/desync/sentinel effects, and an explicit reachability/open-interest invariant, sufficient to attempt P/I/V formalization.
